acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass talks to producer Zoe Chace about what she learned about the President and conspiracy theories at a Trump rally.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Writer Jelani Cobb travels to Missouri to talk to people in Ferguson about the troubling deaths of six activists there.
acts.title: Show Me State of Mind

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: A Democrat in Alabama watches helplessly as Russian internet bots play dirty with the 2016 election. But a year later, those same tactics inspire him to organize an election conspiracy of his own. Producer Ben Calhoun has the story.
acts.title: The Red Menace Hits the Crimson Tide
